root_cause: The production Composio Project API key was rotated after the previous provider validation failure, while the currently deployed Netlify Functions bundle still predated that rotation. A fresh deploy-relevant Functions build is required before provider revalidation can prove the new runtime configuration.
prevention_rule: After rotating a security-sensitive runtime credential used by Netlify Functions, require a fresh production Functions deployment and provider readback before treating the credential change as effective. Do not infer runtime activation from control-plane storage alone.
evidence: The production Netlify deployment visible before this lineage predates the key rotation.
The existing Composio sync function is the runtime consumer of COMPOSIO_API_KEY.
Provider readiness remains unproven until a post-rotation deployment executes and Supabase/Composio readback is observed.

historical_replay: production deploy timestamp vs configuration rotation timestamp

terminal_rule: LIVE_BEWEZEN only after protected merge, post-rotation Netlify production deployment, provider validation, and Supabase setup-state readback.
